subject: Availability redress request — Aurasys (Mar 7 outage)
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@aurasys.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Rios <maya.rios@aurasys.io>, billing@aurasys.io
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Availability impact on Mar 7 — request for redress

Hi Rachel,

On Saturday (Mar 7) between ~03:05–03:47 UTC we saw sustained 5xx errors and timeouts from the Redwood hosted endpoint for our inference cluster. We pulled logs and measured ~42 minutes of meaningful impact for our production traffic (details attached).

Per our SLA we believe Aurasys is eligible for a pro-rated credit for the affected time window. Can you confirm next steps and an estimate of the credit amount? We need the number for our monthly finance accruals and to reconcile our March invoice.

Attachments: uptime-extract-20260307.csv

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Head of Engineering
Aurasys Inc
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@aurasys.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability impact on Mar 7 — request for redress

Sam — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. I'm sorry for the disruption; we take availability issues seriously.

Next steps on our side:
- Ben from Ops will pull our authoritative uptime and request routing logs and produce a proposed credit calculation.
- Laura in Finance will review and authorize the issuance once Ben's calc aligns with SLA terms.
- I'll coordinate a short summary and share a credit note (PDF) for your records.

Ben / Laura — flagging. Targeting to have the proposed calculation and a draft credit note by end of day Wed (Mar 11). If we need any further evidence from Aurasys, I'll let you know.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@aurasys.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability impact on Mar 7 — request for redress

Hi all — I've pulled the serving-side telemetry and customer routing traces. Quick notes:
- Root cause: transient network flapping inside the us-west-2 autoscaler group led to >50% of Aurasys prefix requests being retried and some hitting the 5xx path. (Jira INF-6142)
- We verified the window Sam reported; our edge logs show elevated error rate from 03:03:45–03:44:10 UTC.

I ran a preliminary credit calculation following the SLA formula (monthly uptime target 99.9%). Calculation attached (credit-calculation-aurasys-20260310.xlsx). Summary:
- Total monthly billable usage for Mar (projected): $124,300
- Affected window: 40.4 minutes of degraded availability after accounting for client-side retries and prefix-level mitigations
- Pro-rated credit (per SLA section 4.2): 0.93% of monthly billable = ~$1,156

Laura — please review and confirm whether we can issue a $1,156 credit against the Mar invoice. If we want to apply a small buffer (round up) for customer goodwill I'll defer to your guidance.

Sam — attaching the calculation and the salient log extracts. Let me know if you'd like more granularity.

Attachments: credit-calculation-aurasys-20260310.xlsx, uptime-extract-20260307.csv

Regards,
Ben Carter
Support Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@aurasys.io>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability impact on Mar 7 — request for redress

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the spreadsheet and the math looks correct to me. A couple of operational notes:
- Finance will issue a credit memo applied to the Mar invoice; we can either apply the credit now or issue a one-time negative invoice (customer preference).
- For speed, I recommend issuing $1,200 (rounding up) as a gesture of goodwill; it's still within our delegated approval threshold for credits under $5k.

Rachel — please confirm how Aurasys would prefer to receive the credit (apply to invoice vs standalone credit memo) and we'll prepare the signed credit note. Once Sam confirms, I'll sign off and route to Billing for issuance.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@aurasys.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability impact on Mar 7 — request for redress

Sam — thanks for the quick reply on preference (apply to Mar invoice). Per Laura's sign-off, Redwood will issue a $1,200 credit memo applied to your March invoice. We've prepared a short credit note for signature; link below to sign via DocuSign. Once signed, Billing will post the credit and you should see it reflected on the invoice within 48 hours.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/aurasys-credit-4821
Jira reference: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-6142

Attachments: signed-credit-note-aurasys.pdf (to be populated after signature)

Apologies again for the disruption and thanks for working through the details with us. If you'd like a short postmortem call next week to walk through mitigations we can schedule 30 minutes.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
